item.title: The Greenland deal: US moving in on the Arctic
item.description: US President Donald Trump got his way on the Greenland deal. Denmark and the island have signed an agreement to allow the United States to expand its military presence there. So, what does that mean for the Arctic region and the American relationship with Europe? Join us for that conversation with guests Karen Kwiatkowski, former US Air Force Officer, and David Pyne, Deputy Executive Director of the Task Force on National & Homeland Security.

item.title: The GOP is looking to win the midterms
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes discusses the recent RNC midterm convention. Usually conventions are only held in presidential election years. But this time Trump and MAGA are looking to reinvigorate the party as it stares down the barrel of the gun of Democrats flipping both the House and Senate. Can the GOP parry the blow and keep at least the Senate and maybe both chambers, or will the legislative branch be stripped from the president’s grasp? Joining Scottie for this discussion are conservative pundit Steve Malzberg and the host of the Mike Schwartz show, Mike Schwartz.

item.title: The Curse of the Bearded Lady
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes is joined by author and commentator A.J. Rice. The two discuss Rice’s new book, ‘The Curse of the Bearded Lady’, and the way the trans agenda has shaped so much of American cultural discourse over the past decade. Is the tide turning and is the woke movement finally on its deathbed, or are we doomed to deal with bearded ladies for the foreseeable future? Don’t miss it!

item.title: Trump & Mamdani: A political match made in heaven or hell?
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes takes a look at the relationship between NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani and President Donald Trump. Trump has repeatedly denigrated the kind of communism Mamdani seems to espouse. But when it comes to practicality, Trump seems willing to work with the leader of his hometown. Join us for this conversation with the director of the Ron Paul Institute, Daniel McAdams, and veteran political consultant Robert Hornack.

item.title: Rich Baris and the major midterm predictions
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes is joined by pollster extraordinaire Rich Baris, Director of Big Poll Data and Hist, Inside the Numbers. The two discuss the major predictions ahead of the midterm elections in just a couple of weeks. Will the GOP manage to pull one out against all odds, or are the Democrats set to repeat history and turn the legislative branch against President Trump and his agenda?

item.title: The impact of Trump’s foreign policy on the midterm elections
item.description: On this episode of America First with Scottie Nell Hughes, we ask whether Trump’s foreign policy is going to have a significant impact on the GOP’s chances in the midterms. As many analysts have noted, the war in Iran has caused inflation and soaring prices for Americans, particularly for diesel and gas. Scottie is joined by her panel, Jamarl Thomas, geopolitical analyst and podcast host, and Tom Norton, national director of the America First PAC, to discuss all of this and more.
